compiled_state.title: Rewrite test-cycle-arbiter.sh: invoke arbiter on fixture inputs, assert computed ruling
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Depends On
161e-09ca-f8a9-4ceb (compute_ruling_from_fixture entrypoint)

## Story DD Coverage
DD3, DD4, DD6: test replays inputs through arbiter and asserts computed ruling.

## Implementation Notes
Rewrite tests/scripts/test-cycle-arbiter.sh so each test:
1. Loads fixture JSON from tests/fixtures/arbiter/
2. Calls python3 to invoke compute_ruling_from_fixture(fixture) from dso_ci_review.arbiter
3. Asserts the computed ruling matches fixture['expected_ruling']

Python invocation pattern per test:
```bash
computed_ruling=$(python3 -c "
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/scripts')
from dso_ci_review.arbiter import compute_ruling_from_fixture
fixture = json.load(open('$fixture_file'))
result = compute_ruling_from_fixture(fixture)
print(result['ruling'])
")
```

For schema-collision fixture: the fixture has ruling=BLOCK (new schema) + old_schema_ruling_for_test field.
Expected handling = 'graceful'. Assert: computed_ruling == 'BLOCK' (new schema takes precedence;
old_schema_ruling_for_test is a non-ruling field and is ignored by compute_ruling_from_fixture).
